reviews.comment: Tara is super energetic, and she genuinely loves what she teaches. The class has three exams, with one focused on Excel and Access. There are weekly quizzes, so you really have to stay on top of the material. Overall, it's a challenging course, but if you put in the work, you'll get the results you're looking for.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: She is super nice and cares a lot, but her exams are overly complicated and her class structure could use work (class time spent on meaningless things, lectures are purely videos that you have to watch outside of class). Also, she got very behind on grading, which made it difficult to know where you stood in the class and was pretty frustrating.

Tara is great, but sometimes wasn't the easiest to learn from. She's better at helping you 1-on-1 than strictly learning from the lectures. There are a lot of assignments, but they're fairly manageable and she is happy to help.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: This was a great class, very informative and lowkey fun, but if you're an ok student, don't expect an A.

This class is what ISTM 210 could have been if Phinney wasn't sometimes a little bit insufferable. Live laugh love Tara Blasor, a lot of it is self-teaching but the Canvas is organized and the material really isn't too bad. The MS Excel/ Access practical could save you if you're shooting for an A but averaging Bs on the exams.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Tara is so kind and genuine! She loves her students and has great auditing experience. This class wasn't super easy, but doable with effort! You learn a ton in Excel, SAP, and Access with hw. They take time but are so helpful. There is a 2hr class ea Fri and weekly lecture videos, quizzes and attendance points. 2 exam + final and excel/access test.

tara is AMAZING. take her. an a is achievable, super easy b- lots of hw but she's super accessible and tests are totally fine if u don't cram. 427 actually prepares u for the real world and ppa internships! she cares about students and tries her best to make classes fun and engaging. literally the best prof i've had at mays!

Tara is an awesome professor. It is refreshing to have a professor that actually puts effort into engaging students. If you put in the effort and go to office hours it is not difficult to do well in this class. She helped change my opinion of accounting as a finance major and I am happy to have got to know her. 10/10 recommend.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Blasor is awesome and if you have a chance to take her do it. Her class is never the easiest but she makes it to where if you do the work you will get the grade you want. I have had her 3 separate times. One of the most down to earth and ready to help professors I have had.
Really good prof. Exams are tough but an A is definitely doable. She genuinely cares about her students and wants you to succeed.

I don't enjoy the class, but Tara makes it a lot better. I'm not a fan of online lectures which this class is run on, and it is a lot of Excel, access, and SAP. So, the class structure I don't love, but it is all very helpful and useful stuff for the future, and Tara is great at helping. Diaz is great I've heard too, so you can't go wrong.
The class is hard no matter the professor. Miss Blasor is very sweet and she'll try her best to ensure you pass the class. ACCT 327 is brutal just start studying early and you'll be fine.

Acct 327 is a nightmare but Tara is very fair. She expects you to study about 10 hours a week, but is very accessible outside of class. It's structured like 229 with weekly quizzes, 3 tests, and a cumulative final. Attendance and the textbook are key to success. If you want to get into PPA, you MUST make this class your top priority!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Test heavy

reviews.comment: This class is extremely fair. If you take the time to learn how to do it, you receive a good grade. If you wait till last minute, you will not. The exams were doable if you studied and it was very clear how to succeed in class. Blasor great professor and person overall. 10/10.
Great professor but a really hard class especially as someone who is not a business major.

Blasor is an amazing professor! Definitely one of the best I've had so far. This class is just hard! I would recommend spending everyday on this class to really nail down the concepts. Only missed a B by 3 points (AKA 1 question on the final).

This class sucks but Professor Blasor does an amazing job of teaching it. She is someone that always has a smile on her face and try's her best to keep you engaged and at attention. I am not sure if I could have gotten through this class if she wasn't my professor. If you have a chance to take her in the future do it

327 is a pain no matter what, and Blasor is one of the toughest professors. She gives you a ton of resources to practice with (practice problems, online homework, practice tests), but the tests themselves are still really hard. Really accessible and helpful outside of class, but she does have a hard cut off for grades at the end of the semester

Tara is incredible. Highly recommend for ACCT 427. She responds to emails really quickly and gives great feedback. She is really understanding and wants us to learn the information. I took this class over the summer and if you stay on top of the work, you will be fine.

I absolutely loved Tara when i took ACCT 327 over the summer(which I recommend). She is a fantastic teacher and really does her best to make sure you truly understand the topics. She also wants you to succeed, unlike some profs, and so use her as a resource outside of class. An A is not too difficult but you must be willing to put serious time in

Tara is an absolutely amazing prof, especially for a difficult class like ACCT 327. She teaches it in a way you will remember it and actively tries to help you, even on tests. You have to read and do practice problems outside of class though if you want a good grade. The information can be hard to grasp at times so you have to put the work in.

ACCT 327 is an extremely difficult (but definitely doable) class that requires a lot of time, especially during the summer which was when I took it. There's so many details and rules that it's hard to remember everything, but Tara makes it as easy as it can be. She is 100% my favorite professor at A&M so far, she genuinely cares and is super sweet.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Tara is hands down the best 327 teacher. She cares so much about her students, and just wants them to succeed. She has a schedule of homework problems to follow after every class, which helps you stay on top of the material. Gives old practice tests and a few quizzes to help you prepare for tests. Tests are hard, but are doable. Gives easy pop quiz
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Inspirational--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: She tries to involve students in class and use real world examples - pretty helpful. I took the class in the summer and was close to getting an A. Class requires a lot of dedication!
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: ACCT 327 is a very difficult class. Tara however, was a real big help. She seemed like she genuinely cared that not only we did well but that we actually were grasping the material. Highly recommend her for this class
reviews.ratingTags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Literally one of the hardest classes at Mays. Professor Blasor genuinely cares for her students and answers questions.  I definitely recommend her!

I took the course with her this summer, and really enjoyed it. It was very tough, and def a hard class. But if you put in the work it's not that bad, really! I made an A on every test except for the second one, I made a B. I would suggest taking the course in the summer rather than regular semesters. Tara is great! Good teaching style!

She is very nice and easy to talk to and she really cares about your success.  The class is just hard overall, she has the highest Q-drop tho so I think i would have done better with another teacher but still a really good one.
Awesome prof- sucky class
